common.offline: No connection. Showing pages you have already visited.

push_invite.title: Want us to let you know?
push_invite.body: A notification when your order ships, when a coupon is about to expire, and when cashback arrives. No marketing, and you can turn it off any time.
push_invite.label: Notification suggestion

export.title: Download my data
export.intro: One file with everything your account holds: details, addresses, orders, vouchers, wallet, reviews and wishlist.
export.cardsNote: Saved cards are exported without the chargeable token: brand, last four digits and expiry only.
export.errorRateLimited: Data downloads are limited to three per hour. Please try again in a few minutes.
export.errorGeneric: We could not produce the file. Please try again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
export.errorNetwork: We could not produce the file. Check your connection and try again.

account.invoicesEmpty: No invoices yet. They are issued automatically after every payment.
account.businessInvoiceIntro: Future invoices will be issued to the business name and registration number instead of your own name, starting with the next one issued. Invoices already issued do not change.
account.businessInvoiceToggle: Issue invoices to a business name

environment.label: Test environment
environment.preview: This is a test environment. The data is not real and no real card should be used here.
environment.local: Local server. The data is not real and no real card should be used here.

supplier.dealsFeedNote: Optional. An https URL to a JSON or CSV file of your deals. Checked every 6 hours; every row is reviewed before it publishes.
supplier.dealsManualSubmitted: Sent to the KenyonExpress team for review.

gift.deliverHint: Leave empty and the gift goes out right after payment.
gift.notice: On the send date the recipient gets an email with a personal link to collect the coupon. Until they do, it stays in your account, and the code and QR are shown only to them.

voucherExpiry.creditUsable: You can spend it on any purchase on the site.

orderTracking.title: Track your order
orderTracking.loading: One moment, checking where your order is…
orderTracking.expiredBody: Tracking links are valid for a limited time. Your order and its shipping details are in your account.
orderTracking.invalidBody: It may have been copied only partially. Your order and its shipping details are in your account.
orderTracking.missingBody: We could not find this order. Your orders are in your account.
orderTracking.noPhysical: Nothing in this order ships. The coupons you bought are waiting in your account, under My coupons.
orderTracking.estimateSuffix: Counted in business days. This is an estimate, not a commitment.
orderTracking.overdueSuffix: and the order has not arrived.
orderTracking.overdueTail: and we will look into it.
orderTracking.privacyNote: This page shows delivery status only. Payment, invoice and refund details are in your account.

referralLeaderboard.empty: No referral was credited this month. First place is open.
referralLeaderboard.outsideTop: The last row is yours, at your real rank rather than at the bottom of the list.

referralEmail.creditNote: The bonus is site credit only and cannot be withdrawn as cash.
